reviewer: Codex UI sub-agent; AI visual review, not human or team sign-off
review_method: Opened each original PNG using view_image. Compared raw SHA256 and actual PNG IHDR dimensions with the attempt2 browser record. No contact-sheet replacement, image editing or regeneration was used.
shared_observations: All 24 originals have readable navigation, content, controls and footers at the two requested desktop viewports.
U09 visibly uses teaching simulation text, original persisted order amount and no banking or real payment-data inputs.
Expanded cancellation prompts visibly explain the affected order, stock return and no cart restoration before the confirmation button.
Mock failure, mock success and cancellation flashes are distinguishable and explain the resulting state.
A later, deliberately nonempty Alice cart keeps badge 1 through payment and cancellation. That badge does not mean purchased goods were restored. Bob foreign-order 404 shows his own badge 0.
Paid and shipped views retain first-payment receipt/time; cancelled views retain cancellation time and omit pending actions.
Shipping values on U08 are covered with three opaque grey masks. U09/error/conflict pages contain no shipping panel.
limitations: This is AI visual review of these exact 24 PNGs, not human acceptance, assistive-technology testing or mobile-viewport verification.

PNG content alone does not prove HTTP 303, actual request result parameters, transaction isolation, lock order, SQL effects, receipt uniqueness, microsecond timestamps or no-write branches. Those conclusions require the separate raw HTTP, browser interception, native SQL and database evidence.

The real browser FAILURE-to-SUCCESS and cancellation journeys are separately observed in attempt2 HTTP/browser records. Each screenshot represents a resulting page; it is not a replacement for the redirect response trace.
Shipping masks intentionally prevent visual checking of raw recipient, phone, address and their escaping. Screenshot review does not expose session IDs, CSRF tokens or plaintext passwords.
Full-page PNG heights differ from viewport heights and are recorded individually. A tall screenshot is not a claim that all content appeared above the fold.
No concurrency or injected failure testing is claimed; those remain STEP13.
Failed attempt1 is retained separately. Its 24 original screenshots were not modified by this review, and no missing native database proof is reconstructed from attempt2.

native_log_crosscheck.scope: ParamMap regression and actual private-DB PaymentService sequential operations; no HTTP, order creation, concurrency or injected-failure claim
native_log_crosscheck.note: Read from the actual attempt2 log. This visual-review step did not independently execute native SQL again.
